title: Rekognition, Textract, Kendra and Personalize

kcs.statement: Amazon Rekognition analyses images and video to detect objects, people, text and unsafe content, and to compare faces.
Amazon Textract extracts printed and handwritten text, forms and tables from scanned documents; Comprehend can then analyse the meaning of that text.
Amazon Kendra is ML-powered intelligent search over an organisation's documents; Amazon Personalize generates real-time recommendations from user behaviour.

problem_ideas: An insurer scans 10,000 claim forms a day and needs the field values: which service?
A social app must flag inappropriate uploaded images: which service?
Staff need to ask 'what is our parental leave policy?' over 40,000 HR documents: Kendra or OpenSearch?
An online shop wants 'customers like you also bought': which service?
Spot the distractor: 'Rekognition reads the meaning of a contract.'
Order a pipeline: scanned letters to extracted text to detected sentiment.
